outpatient visit, Endocrinology, Dr. Maria Gonzalez
Increasing fatigue and difficulty climbing stairs
6-month history of increasing fatigue and difficulty climbing stairs. She reports that she has gained 20 pounds during this period despite no significant changes in her diet or exercise routine.
outpatient visit, Rheumatology, Dr. Aisha Patel
Follow-up after being diagnosed with type II diabetes mellitus three months ago

This 45-year-old female with Cushing syndrome diagnosed three months ago in Endocrinology, systemic lupus erythematosus, and type 2 diabetes mellitus returns for follow-up regarding immunosuppressant use. She reports occasional dizziness when standing up quickly but denies chest pain, shortness of breath, or palpitations.

Primary care physician starts her on a new antihypertensive. The physician explains that the new medication works by interfering with a hormone that normally narrows blood vessels and that the drug also has protective benefits for the kidneys in diabetics.
outpatient visit, Internal Medicine, Dr. Robert Kim
The patient returns for routine diabetes follow-up in the context of known Cushing syndrome and systemic lupus erythematosus. She has been managing her diabetes with metformin and a balanced diet.
outpatient visit, Endocrinology, Dr. Maria Gonzalez
Presents to the clinic for a routine follow-up

The patient returns for follow-up of Cushing syndrome and Type 2 diabetes mellitus. She reports adherence to her diet and exercise regimen, but she has been experiencing frequent episodes of diaphoresis and palpitations, particularly in the early mornings.
ed visit, Emergency Medicine, Dr. James Wilson
Sudden onset of confusion and slurred speech that began 2 hours ago

This 50-year-old female with Type 2 diabetes mellitus, hypertension, Cushing syndrome, and systemic lupus erythematosus on chronic prednisone therapy, who experienced severe hypoglycemia in 2022, is brought to the emergency department by her husband due to sudden onset confusion and slurred speech that began two hours ago. She has been compliant with her medications, which include metformin, insulin glargine, lisinopril, and prednisone.
Endocrinology: Follow-up after low blood sugar ER visit (in 2 days)

privacyRules.rule: Keep the names of diagnoses and related medications for diabetes, Cushing syndrome, hypertension, lupus, and stroke out of SMS messages.
privacyRules.reason: Sensitive health information should not be included in SMS for privacy and security.

cognitiveSupport.text: Ana, you have experienced a stroke in the past, so we will make sure to communicate clearly and check in if anything is confusing. If your husband is helping you, he is welcome to join our conversations.
cognitiveSupport.reason: Stroke history may impact communication or memory, so clear, supportive communication is important.
